title: Concurrent duplicate qualification-path reconciliation

concurrent_commits.message: test(F-DOC03): add fail-closed core traceability validator
ci(F-DOC03): add exact-head core traceability qualification

finding: The two concurrent commits duplicated F-DOC03 qualification machinery after the already green canonical closeout/status head. The duplicate validator was non-equivalent to the canonical validator and expected RB1-CORE-MASS T1 capability status GAP rather than the canonical GAP_SOURCE_BINDING_OPEN with a referenced T1 node whose node status is GAP. The duplicate workflow therefore cannot become a second authority path.
validity_rule: This reconciliation becomes final F-DOC03 authority only when the retained canonical workflow .github/workflows/fdoc03-rb1-core-traceability.yml succeeds with head_sha equal to the exact reconciliation commit and the branch ref remains on that exact head.
